sb_prompt: PLEASE DISCUSS CREDIT CARDS.  FIND OUT HOW THE OTHER CALLER MAKES USE OF CREDIT CARDS.  HOW DO THEY COMPARE TO YOUR OWN?
turns: So, how are you even using them? Do you just carry them around or do you actually pay the bill every month?

Honestly, I use them for everything—groceries, gas, sometimes even takeout—but I do pay the full bill every month, though honestly, sometimes I just pay a little extra to get rid of the interest before I forget.
